name: Shoal
description: Shoal for Jellyfin: a friend's titles show up in your library as lightweight .strm/.nfo entries and play through an authenticated plugin proxy, with the friend's server deciding between direct play and transcoding for your client. Nothing is copied and nothing is exposed.
overview: Share libraries between friends' Jellyfin servers. Nothing copied, nothing exposed.

versions.changelog: Shoal 2.9.2 (includes 2.9.1): friend titles now say which friend hosts them and carry a Shared by entry in the Studios filter. A friend server only lists libraries it shares with you, and a picked library can no longer be swapped for another with the same name. TV shows from friends are always on (servers that had TV off start syncing their mapped TV libraries on the next sync). Held titles show real examples, a stopped play frees its stream slot at once, a refused play says why, and removing a server or library clears its empty library. Fixes Remove library. The first sync after upgrading rewrites friend titles once. Back up the shoal data folder first.

What is new: library layouts and presets (including Combine into my libraries, so friends titles appear inside your own libraries); one title with backup servers, and a priority order that decides which friend plays first; a quality limit per friend with a speed-test suggestion; a plain-words label so people know why a title is where it is; an inbox message for your users; new admin pages (Overview, Library layouts, Priority, Quality). Upgrading: the first sync rewrites movie descriptions once. Shoal state moves to schema 3 on the next change. To go back to 1.2.x you must restore a state backup first, otherwise 1.2.x opens in recovery mode. Safety fixes: Remove everything never deletes a library that holds your own folders, and Combine into my libraries works when you have no library of a type. Back up the shoal data folder before upgrading. Moonfin is recommended as the client.

Hotfix: safety code no longer shows undefined on the pairing step; wizard advances when the friend approves; readable error bar; no duplicate titles when an older server returns; steadier quality after a link drop.
Spike: PlaybackInfo interception + authenticated stream proxy.
Pairing guidance (ask for an invite, home network address warning), certificate trust shows the fingerprint before pinning, edit and remove friend servers, Overlap report.
Fixes: the Add and start syncing button did nothing; a fresh install now picks its library folder automatically; add errors show next to the button.
